title: ReportPlugin
description: A modern Minecraft reporting plugin with a full GUI system, database support, and Discord webhook integration for efficient staff moderation.
body:
ReportPlugin is a lightweight yet fully featured reporting system designed for Minecraft servers.
It allows players to submit detailed reports directly in-game, while staff members can review, manage, and act on them through an intuitive GUI-based interface. All reports are saved in a database for long-term tracking and can optionally be sent to a Discord channel using a Webhook integration.

The plugin includes a multi-step report creation process, a full reports list GUI, and management actions such as viewing details, marking reports as resolved, and more. It also features message customization, configurable options, and a clean user experience for both players and staff.
(API) 
This project aims to provide an efficient and streamlined reporting workflow without requiring additional dependencies.
